content: bslib 0.12.0 (CRAN, 2026-08-04): Bootstrap Sass themes for Shiny/RMarkdown/pkgdown. Imports sass, htmltools, jquerylib, jsonlite, rlang, memoise. Imported by pkgdown. brand.yml integration: _brand.yml file defines colors, typography, logos; referenced from _pkgdown.yml via template.bslib.brand: _brand.yml. Bootswatch themes available. bs_theme() underpins pkgdown Bootstrap 5 theming. For pkgdown, bslib is NOT something the package itself needs to depend on — it is a dev/CI tool used by pkgdown. The package author never imports bslib in their R package DESCRIPTION; only pkgdown (which is already dev-only) uses it.
